sql: SELECT name, type FROM sqlite_master WHERE type IN ('table','view') ORDER BY name

SELECT 'items_g2' t, name, type FROM pragma_table_info('items_g2') UNION ALL SELECT 'fdbk_g2', name, type FROM pragma_table_info('fdbk_g2') UNION ALL SELECT 'taxn_g2', name, type FROM pragma_table_info('taxn_g2')

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM items_g2) items, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fdbk_g2) reviews, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM items_g2 WHERE prc IS NOT NULL) prc_nn, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM taxn_g2 WHERE cat_lvl=0) lvl0, (SELECT DISTINCT cat_nm FROM taxn_g2 WHERE cat_lvl=0) lvl0name

SELECT
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fdbk_g2 WHERE rtg IS NULL) rtg_null,
 (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT cat_nm) FROM taxn_g2 WHERE cat_lvl=0) roots,
 (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(cat_nm||':'||c, ', ') FROM (SELECT cat_nm, COUNT(*) c FROM taxn_g2 WHERE cat_lvl=0 GROUP BY cat_nm)) root_counts,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM items_g2 i WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM taxn_g2 t WHERE t.ref_id=i.ref_id AND t.cat_lvl=0)) no_tax_root,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM items_g2 WHERE prc_usd IS NULL AND prc IS NOT NULL) pnc,
 (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ref_id) FROM fdbk_g2) items_with_rev
SELECT cat_nm, COUNT(*) c FROM taxn_g2 WHERE cat_lvl=0 GROUP BY cat_nm
SELECT COUNT(*) rtg_null FROM fdbk_g2 WHERE rtg IS NULL

SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM (
  SELECT i.ref_id
  FROM items_g2 i JOIN fdbk_g2 f ON f.ref_id = i.ref_id
  WHERE COALESCE(i.prc_usd, i.prc/100.0) > 50
  GROUP BY i.ref_id
  HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5 AND AVG(f.rtg) < 3.0
)

SELECT
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT i.ref_id FROM items_g2 i JOIN fdbk_g2 f ON f.ref_id=i.ref_id WHERE i.prc_usd>50 GROUP BY i.ref_id HAVING COUNT(*)>=5 AND AVG(f.rtg)<3.0)) only_usd,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM items_g2 i JOIN fdbk_g2 f ON f.ref_id=i.ref_id WHERE COALESCE(i.prc_usd,i.prc/100.0)>50 GROUP BY i.ref_id HAVING COUNT(*)>=5 AND AVG(f.rtg)<3.0) with_agg

SELECT i.ref_id, i.prc_usd, i.prc, COUNT(*) rc, ROUND(AVG(f.rtg),3) avg_rtg, i.avg_rtg AS item_avg_rtg, i.main_cat
FROM items_g2 i JOIN fdbk_g2 f ON f.ref_id=i.ref_id
WHERE COALESCE(i.prc_usd,i.prc/100.0) > 50
GROUP BY i.ref_id
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5 AND AVG(f.rtg) < 3.0
ORDER BY i.ref_id
